name: TDD Bug Fix
intent: Fix bugs by first reproducing them with a failing test, then implementing and verifying the fix.

source.text: For bug fixes, write or identify a failing test before implementation. Confirm it fails for the expected reason, make the minimal fix, then rerun focused and broader verification.

inputs.description: A bug report, failing behavior, or regression description.

outputs.description: A test-first bug fix plan with implementation and verification.

steps.title: Reproduce with failing test
steps.description: Write or select a test that fails for the reported bug before implementation.

steps.title: Implement fix
steps.description: Make the smallest code change needed to pass the failing test.

steps.title: Rerun verification
steps.description: Rerun the focused test and relevant broader checks.

rules.sourceText: Write the failing test before implementing the fix.
rules.normalizedForm: A failing test is mentioned before implementation.

rules.sourceText: Rerun tests before claiming the bug is fixed.
rules.normalizedForm: The response includes verification after the fix.

checks.name: Failing test before implementation
checks.assertion: The response mentions a failing test before implementation.

checks.name: Concrete fix stated
checks.assertion: The response includes a concrete fix.

checks.name: Verification step stated
checks.assertion: The response includes focused and broader verification.
